nodes.heading: One operator across the whole conversion loop.
nodes.html:
03

End-to-end creative growth

One operator across the whole conversion loop.

I connect buyer insight, creative production, paid media, and booking / follow-up so the idea survives every handoff.

  1. 01

    Find the buying tension

    Identify the friction, desire, or decision that makes the offer matter now.

  2. 02

    Make it instantly visible

    The problem, promise, and next action register before attention disappears.

  3. 03

    Build distinct routes in

    Every variation tests a different reason to stop, believe, or act.

  4. 04

    Follow the signal downstream

    Connect creative decisions to qualified leads, bookings, and acquisition economics.

nodes.html:
06

Where I create leverage

A performance creative operator who understands the whole funnel.

I do my best work where creative judgment meets paid acquisition and conversion systems: developing the angles, directing production, reading the signal, and improving what happens after the click.

01

Performance creative strategy

Territory maps, hooks, offers, scripts, storyboards, and briefs rooted in buyer psychology.

02

Performance creative

Meta campaign structure, creative testing, CPL optimization, lead qualification, and analysis.

03

AI production systems

Generative image and video production, visual continuity, post-production handoffs, and scalable asset systems.

04

The conversion layer

Landing pages, GoHighLevel / HubSpot, speed-to-lead, nurture, booking, and measurement after the click.
